name: Man-Made Gentleman Barbers
observations: Cream upper facade with dark framed multi-pane windows; broad dark/black lower frontage surround.
Black fascia carries large light MAN-MADE/GENTLEMAN BARBERS lettering and circular emblems.
Lower glazing divided into display window and door with transom; vertical black service boards flank the opening.
Barber poles/brackets project near fascia ends; lettering and poles should be separate sharp assets.
Dark window framing contrasts with pale wall and neighbouring white Costcutter block.
Sidewalk is shallow and flush to lower facade; roadside vehicle is an occlusion, not part of the frontage.
unknowns: Exact dimensions, rear elevation and interior layout are not established. Street View address is a camera label, not this unit address.
review_basis: All listed captures reviewed in contact sheets; selected originals also inspected at native resolution. Notes describe visible appearance, not surveyed construction.
